findings.body: Raise: Not done. `check_pin` parses the current `forge.toml` at line 668 before the new handback branch reads the pin from the handout's HEAD. If a native subagent leaves an uncommitted malformed edit to `forge.toml` and handback runs from the item's checkout, parsing refuses the command before handback can restore the file. The named restore behavior therefore fails for that edit.
findings.title: Not done: handback restores an invalid forge.toml edit

findings.body: Raise: Not done. Handback records a timing here, but neither handout nor handback records the promised `run end` event. `machine.leave` only removes the lane entry; kit runs use `repo.record_run` to write their start and end events. Native rounds therefore lack the usual finished-run record, and the new test checks timing without checking that event.
findings.title: Not done: record the native build run end

findings.body: Raise: Not done. On the next `forge land` call after a successful handback with no work commit, the item's HEAD is still the `item is working` status commit. The condition at lines 42–45 calls `_handed_out` again, which starts another native build round instead of reaching close. The named after-handback behavior works in the new test only because its subagent commits a file.
findings.title: Not done: land proceeds to close after a handed-back round with no commit

findings.body: Raise: Gate. This change replaces metadata in `docs/specs/codex-chat-view.read.md`, which is outside the allowed paths and is unrelated to the native build-round work. It is not the FORGE-TOOLS-1 story's read notes, which the scope rule excludes from this check.
findings.title: Gate: unrelated cold-read notes changed outside Scope
